question.text: As per current Indian regulatory norms, which style of commodity options is permitted on exchanges?

answer.text: European style only - exercisable only on the expiry date
American style only - exercisable any time before or on expiry
Asian style - based on average price

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, only European-style commodity options are permitted on Indian derivatives exchanges, applying to both Options on Futures and Options on Goods. The Trap: American style (exercisable any time before expiry) is not permitted for commodity options in India under the rules set out in the workbook. The "both styles" option is therefore also wrong. Note: European-style options can be exercised only on the expiry date, which simplifies the writer's risk management by eliminating early-exercise risk.
